prereg.selection: Per target the best validation score wins (V: R2, O5: log loss, D10: Brier). Candidates: numbers only, and numbers and/or images from every pretrained backbone, frozen or fine-tuned (Stage 5F), on equal terms. A model that uses chart images is chosen only if (a) its validation gain over the best numbers-only model has a month-block 95% CI that excludes 0 AND (b, new in v4) the gain has the right sign in every validation year separately (a gain made in one year only is not trusted). The 2020-2022 test years and the exposed 2023+ holdout are never used to choose.
prereg.finetune: Fine-tuning (Stage 5F): each pretrained backbone is trained end to end (shared backbone over the three views + 33 numbers, multi-task loss: MSE on volatility, plain cross-entropy on direction and drawdown; AdamW, warm-up + cosine schedule, no augmentation). v4: it learns from training rows whose labels end before FT_INNER, and early stopping uses the FT_INNER slice of the training years, so the validation years are untouched by fine-tuning. A controlled study (last 25% / 50% of the network, risk-only loss) runs on the best backbones; per backbone the variant with the lowest inner-validation risk loss is carried forward. Extra seeds measure run-to-run variation and are not used for selection.
prereg.thresholds: Decision thresholds for precision / recall / F1 (drawdown and direction) are the F1-maximising thresholds on the calibrated VALIDATION probabilities, fixed before the test years are read.
prereg.monte_carlo: Stage 7M: the simulation's tail shape and intraday-low range are chosen on validation (return coverage, then drawdown Brier); the dashboard matches the drawdown model by default unless that worsens the validation coverage error by more than 1 percentage point. Checked once on the test years.
prereg.H1: On the test years, the best numbers+images model (chosen on validation among pretrained backbones) beats the numbers-only model: the 95% CI of delta-R2 (volatility) or delta-AUC (direction) lies above 0.
prereg.H2: On validation, image-only volatility R2 differs between at least two pretrained backbones (pairwise month-block bootstrap, Holm-adjusted p < 0.05).
prereg.H3: On the test years, accuracy of direction calls at 10% coverage (confidence threshold fixed on validation) exceeds accuracy at 100% coverage: the 95% CI of the difference lies above 0.
prereg.no_trade: NO TRADE unless direction is usable, confidence passes its validation threshold, and neither predicted volatility nor drawdown probability is in its validation top 20%. Direction is usable only if (a) on validation the Wilson lower bound of accuracy exceeds 0.5 at some coverage AND (b) on the test years the direction model's AUC 95% CI lies above 0.5 (validation alone is optimistic because it also chose the model).
